about: Conformance rows for verifying a WebAuthn assertion offline (kernel/src/webauthn.ts). Every row is verified with publicKey = keys[row.key], challenge = base64url-decode(row.challenge) (= SHA-256 of row.text), rpId and origins as below, and storedSignCount when the row has one. Match the verdict; match the reason where you can. TEST KEYS ONLY.
